description: Run Tests page — displays Playwright test results and verification phase results for a workflow run. Shows pass/fail summaries, individual test cards with assertions, console output, failure screenshots, error messages, and iteration-grouped verification results.

groups.name: Test Results Summary
groups.description: The Tests page opens with an aggregate summary of all test results from the workflow run. Users need to immediately understand the overall test health: how many passed, how many failed, how many were skipped, and the total count. This summary drives the user's next action — if everything passed they can move on, if tests failed they need to drill into the failures. The summary also includes a loop result banner when the workflow used iterative verification, showing whether verification ultimately passed across all iterations.

assertions.description: The user can see a clear summary showing the number of tests that passed, failed, and were skipped, along with the total test count, giving them an immediate understanding of overall test health

When the workflow used iterative verification, the user sees a loop result banner showing whether verification ultimately passed or failed, the number of iterations run, and a per-iteration quick summary with check counts
The user sees a clear 'Test Results' heading that establishes the purpose of the page and anchors the summary statistics

groups.name: Verification Phase Results by Iteration
groups.description: Verification results are grouped by iteration, reflecting the workflow loop structure. Each iteration is collapsible and shows its own pass/fail status and duration. Within each iteration, individual verification steps are displayed as test cards. Users can drill into any step to see console output, page snapshots, assertion counts, and error details. This hierarchical organization (iteration > step > details) mirrors the execution structure and helps users trace failures to specific verification phases and iterations.

assertions.description: Verification results are organized into collapsible iteration groups, each showing the iteration number, overall pass/fail status, check count, and total duration, allowing the user to quickly identify which iterations had problems

Within each iteration, individual verification steps are shown as expandable cards with the step name, pass/fail status, duration, and test type, allowing the user to drill into specific verification checks

When a verification step fails, the user can expand it to see detailed error information including the error message, console output, and stack traces, providing the diagnostic information needed to fix the issue
The user can see assertion counts (passed/total) for steps that include assertions, helping them understand the granularity of verification success or failure

groups.name: Playwright Test Results
groups.description: In addition to verification phase results, the page displays Playwright browser test results when the workflow included Playwright test execution. Playwright tests provide end-to-end browser verification and produce rich artifacts including failure screenshots, page snapshots (YAML), and console output. These results are displayed separately from verification results since they come from a different execution mechanism.

assertions.description: When Playwright tests were executed during the run, the user sees a dedicated Playwright section with individual test result cards, clearly separated from the verification phase results

For failed Playwright tests, the user can view failure screenshots showing the exact browser state at the time of failure, which is the most valuable debugging artifact for browser-based test failures
The user can view page snapshots (YAML representation of the page structure) captured during test execution, providing a structural view of the page state that complements visual screenshots

groups.name: Empty and Running States
groups.description: The Tests page handles several states gracefully. When no run is selected, it guides the user to select one. When the selected run is still executing, it informs the user that results will be available after completion. When no tests were executed during the run, it explains that tests appear when the workflow includes verification or test steps. These states prevent user confusion and set appropriate expectations.

assertions.description: When no run is selected, the user sees guidance to select a run to view test results, preventing a confusing blank state
When the selected run is still in progress, the user sees a message explaining that test results will be available after the run completes, setting the correct expectation
When the run completed without any tests or verification steps, the user sees an explanatory message that tests appear when the workflow includes verification or test execution steps

states.name: No Run Selected
states.description: The default state when no workflow run is selected. Shows guidance prompting the user to select a run from the Run Dashboard to view test results.

transitions.name: Select a run
transitions.description: User selects a workflow run from the Run Dashboard sidebar, triggering a fetch of test results for that run

states.name: Loading Results
states.description: Test results are being fetched from the backend. A spinner and 'Loading test results...' message are displayed while the data request is in progress.

transitions.name: Results loaded successfully
transitions.description: The fetch completes successfully and returns one or more test results, transitioning to the results view with summary and test cards

transitions.name: No results returned
transitions.description: The fetch completes successfully but no test results exist for the selected run

transitions.name: Fetch fails
transitions.description: The fetch encounters an error (network failure, backend error), transitioning to the error state with a retry option

states.name: Error Loading Results
states.description: An error occurred while fetching test results. Shows an amber warning icon, the error message, and a Retry button that re-triggers the fetch.

transitions.name: Retry fetch
transitions.description: User clicks the Retry button to re-attempt fetching test results for the selected run

states.name: No Test Results
states.description: The selected run completed but no verification tests were executed. Shows an explanatory message that no verification tests were run during the task run.

transitions.name: Select a different run
transitions.description: User selects a different workflow run from the sidebar, triggering a new fetch

states.name: Test Results Displayed
states.description: Test results are loaded and displayed. The summary header shows total test count, passed count, failed count, and total duration. Below the header is a scrollable list of test result cards, each showing status, name, type, duration, and assertion counts. Cards are collapsed by default.

transitions.name: Expand a test result card
transitions.description: User clicks on a test result card header to expand it, revealing detailed output, error messages, timestamps, and AI analysis

transitions.name: Refresh results
transitions.description: User clicks the refresh button in the summary header to re-fetch test results for the current run

transitions.name: Select a different run
transitions.description: User selects a different workflow run from the sidebar, triggering a new fetch

states.name: Test Result Card Expanded
states.description: One or more test result cards are expanded, revealing detailed content below the card header. Expanded content may include error messages (red panel with error text), output logs (pre-formatted text), start/complete timestamps, and AI analysis. The summary header and other collapsed cards remain visible.

transitions.name: Collapse test result card
transitions.description: User clicks the expanded card header again to collapse it, hiding the detail content and returning to the collapsed results list
